title: Your voice clone sample
text: Hi, I'm Mohamed Adib, a student at Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering. I'm working on PlainSign. When a website says Free Mint, the wallet request can mean something very different. It might give someone permission to move every NFT in a collection. I want to make that permission clear before anyone approves it. A free signature can also grant access to tokens later. The goal is to help people understand the request, look at the warning, and then make their own decision.
